citations.quote: At the end of January, I submitted my resignation, and 28 February was my last day as Head of Learning & Development. I knew one thing - my own direction had to change. My Live It Up - Real Estate Training Academy needed my full attention.

I have seen what happens when confidence disappears, old strategies stop working, and the market tests people. 2009 in Kiev, Ukraine - where I was a Head of sales of Real Estate Developer - we had a financial system collapse, accounts were frozen by the government for a whole year. 2018 in Dubai - When the market was slowing down...

summary.text: The author resigned as Head of Learning & Development to focus on their real estate training academy despite market difficulties, highlighting past experiences with difficult economic cycles in 2009 and 2018.
